reponse: Yes, a new one is needed. Victor's 12 Nov mail says that as a service provider Quillon must test segmentation controls at least every six months, and that the March 2026 Redline test only covers the first half [2]. The tracker confirms the only segmentation test on file is the March one, so a second 2026 test is missing [1]. An H2 test is already booked with Redline for Nov 30 – Dec 2, with the report promised Dec 4, ahead of fieldwork on Dec 8 [3][4]. Note the tracker's own reasoning initially assumed the March report was enough [1], which was corrected.
